designs.title: A · 相位环
designs.prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Create a refined fantasy BOW GRIP redesign concept illustration for a geometric luminous weapon collection. One design per image. Landscape 3:2 composition: left quarter a complete slender recurve bow from tip to tip with attached taut bowstring; right three quarters a large detailed three-quarter close-up of the SAME bow's central grip and upper/lower limb roots. Make the close-up dominate, reveal depth and a usable palm-sized handhold. Dark charcoal background, clear elegant negative space, professional game weapon concept painting, extremely crisp silhouettes and precise geometry. Red translucent solid-light construction, darker ruby planes with fine scarlet luminous edges, restrained bloom, very few tiny red motes. Keep the same crimson palette across designs so structure can be compared. NO hexagram, NO star of any number of points, no pentagram, no magical seal, no heraldic medallion. NO metal, leather, filigree, gemstones, screws, guns, people, hands, environment or white-hot glare. The grip itself is the design, not a decorative badge placed on a straight stick. Upper and lower limbs must join the grip coherently, no block in the arrow passage. Intricate but economical abstract forms, buildable-looking thick sections. One small elegant Chinese title at bottom, no other text. Full bow and close-up must agree on the central design. DESIGN A, title exactly "A · 相位环". Architectural orbital / suspended design, light and precise. A compact oval hand space with a substantial flattened faceted grip bridge forming its REAR side, plus two thick separated crescent arcs suspended around the FRONT side at slightly different depths. Arcs terminate in sharply tapered ends and leave broad open gaps, never an enclosed huge round shield. Upper bow root forks around the top of the negative space; lower root mirrors it with a deliberate slight rotational offset. Thin three-piece luminous tracks trace the curve of the arcs. The whole grip reads like a small broken elliptical orbit incorporated into the bow riser; palm clearance clear, grip length around one hand. Very small geometric light fragments at the arc ends, not a floating gem in the middle. Outer bow limbs use restrained repeating angular rails. Dramatic sculptural depth, spacious, sophisticated arcane technology.

A broad, subtly canted prismatic handgrip with a taper at its center. Three short staggered wedge fins grow from the upper root on one side, three complementary fins grow from the lower root on the opposite side, overlapping in depth around the grip like two compact geometric wings sliding past each other. Use asymmetric offset Z-shaped load paths and a narrow diagonal slit of empty space. Fins stay outside the palm and do NOT form stars or a closed ring. Thick dark red faces, razor-clean red edge lights, blunt inner grip faces comfortable enough to hold, sharp outer fin silhouettes. Mechanically convincing shoulders, balanced full bow despite asymmetric local detail. Full bow wings use short repeated triangular blades echoing these stepped vanes. Strong compact structure, militant elegance, keep the riser small relative to the bow, no giant axe-like guard.

Elegant flowing bifurcation / continuous ribbon design, distinctly different from rings and stacked fins. Two broad smooth red solid-light ribbons flow from the upper bow limb into the grip, twist gradually in shallow three-dimensional depth, merge into one substantial ergonomic palm-sized waist, then divide toward the lower limb. Long graceful S curves with clean flattened polygonal cross-sections; gently faceted bevels retain geometric identity. A slim elongated teardrop-shaped negative space sits ABOVE the hand, a complementary slit BELOW it. No object or emblem hangs in front of the palm, no central circular feature. Thin luminous inlay-like edge traces continuously follow the two ribbons; clear dark red main planes, minimal controlled glow. The complete bow extends these same two sweeping bands along the limbs with a few elegant cross bridges. Quiet, refined, aerodynamic, the central grip feels organically continuous with the bow rather than a separate ornament. No vines, animal parts or floral decoration.
